liveProvider.note: Production Chrome proved duplicate-download containment but still failed activation because no WebGPU adapter was available; stale GLUE protocol bytes masked that cause. V0.16.87 carries the adapter preflight and adaptive Scion route.

manualBrowser.note: The production run stopped at model activation, so generation, Agent, responsive, console, and physical ZIP proof did not close for this historical release.

claims.summary: The first production activation failure was initially attributed to the OPFS destination-buffer boundary; follow-up production proof decoded stale GLUE protocol bytes and identified the unavailable WebGPU adapter addressed in V0.16.87.
The generated runtime digest changes while the pinned public Gemma model identity and shard manifest remain unchanged.
Scion runtime startup failures stop native authoring instead of starting a second local-provider course-map attempt.
Scion distinguishes download, activation, and clean-cache replacement without resetting terminal progress.
Failed fresh activation exits before cache removal and retains a prompt-free diagnostic chain.
Runtime recovery is not represented as a model-weight, adapter, instructor, factual, accessibility, or classroom quality result.

carryForward.item: Record production-origin generation, Agent, console, responsive, and physical ZIP proof after deployment.
Keep the optional trained adapter inactive until it beats the pinned public base on the frozen held-out ruler.
Seek independent instructor or classroom evidence before raising the Automated Readiness evidence tier.
